DRASTIC MEASURES

Remove up 2 Plague cubes from the grid.

Play at any time. Not an action.

mechanics.whenRead: Taken with the other new Rationed Events when 01-07 is read, at the end of the first January game. Kept in the reserve and added to the Rationed Event pool.

mechanics.notes: Side A is the shared rationed-event back (haven in a signal ring, yellow bars, red arc). No printed card code and no rules text. Printed 'Remove up 2 Plague cubes', with no 'to' between 'up' and '2'. Word boxes on the scan leave no room for a missing 'to'. Screen title is DRASTIC MEASURES.
